title: fredolia aretioides
intro: Fredolia aretioides, commonly known as the 'Purple Passion Flower', is a plant species in the passionflower family. It has been found to have various health benefits, including its potential to reduce anxiety and insomnia due to its sedative properties. The therapeutic actions of the plant include its ability to treat insomnia, anxiety, and restlessness, as well as its potential to reduce inflammation. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its therapeutic properties.
